name: Static SM90 CTA and cluster tile shapes
summary: Require compile-time CTA and thread-block cluster shapes when constructing Hopper GMMA/TMA collectives.

strategy.intent: Construct a legal and performance-relevant GEMM tile mapping for the target architecture.
strategy.mechanism: Represent TileShape_MNK and ClusterShape_MNK as static CuTe shapes consumed by GMMA selection, TMA multicast, and scheduling.
strategy.expected_benefit: Exposes data reuse and parallel Tensor Core work while respecting layout and resource limits.
tradeoffs: Tile choices change shared-memory use, register pressure, occupancy, and available grid parallelism.

parameters.name: tile_shape_mnk
parameters.description: Tunable or derived tile property: tile_shape_mnk.

parameters.name: cluster_shape_mnk
parameters.description: Tunable or derived tile property: cluster_shape_mnk.

constraints.rationale: Builder selection and layout construction occur at compile time.
Cluster shape must be launchable on Hopper.

references.evidence: The referenced CUTLASS builder/core expression implements this tile decision.
